// RED fixture for `no-raw-publish` — the lint MUST reject this.
// (Bus slice: P-S10 → P-017 froze the lint; EB-07 → P-019 extends it to the BusTransport seam.)
//
// Two distinct write-path raw-publish bug fingerprints, BOTH forbidden:
//  (1) a fire-and-forget direct broker publish_now that bypasses the outbox; and
//  (2) a direct call onto the `BusTransport::put` broker seam (EB-04 → P-013) — the relay's
//      broker-publish call (refined-arch §4.1/§5.2), which only the relay may make.
// In each the event is NOT in the same transaction as the state change; if the process dies after
// the DB commit, the event is lost (the causality-break / lost-event bug class, F5).
pub async fn handle(state: &mut State, broker: &Broker, transport: &T, e: Envelope) {
    state.apply(&e);
    // (1) fire-and-forget publish — bypasses the outbox.
    broker.publish_now(&e).await;
    // (2) direct BusTransport::put — the relay's broker-publish, called from a write path.
    transport.put(e.subject(), &e, e.event_id()).await;
}
